pages.text: With in the $(l:wuxiacraft:cultivation/gui)Introspection Menu$() you can construct different techniques with the aspects you have learned. $(br2)Selecting an aspect from the left hand side you can then place it in the technique grid. Aspects come in four general types:

pages.title: Start Aspect
pages.text: The start aspect is the origin of the path of your technique. $(br2)You can only have 1 start aspect at a time and they will only connect to generator aspects.

pages.title: Generator Aspects
pages.text: The generator aspect will generate a given aspect element. Generator aspects by themselves will not increase your cultivation as they need to be converted into cultivation base. $(br2)These types can connect to the start aspect, other generator aspects of the same element, and converter aspects.

pages.title: Converter Aspects
pages.text: the converter aspect does the hard work of converting what the generator makes into usable cultivation. Converter aspects can only convert as much as you have generated in a given chain. It is imperitive to make sure you only have as many converters as you need. $(br2)Converters can connect to generator aspects and other converter aspects of the same element as well as the gathering aspect.

pages.title: Gathering Aspect
pages.text: Gathering aspects are the final step in the chain. They will take all the cultivation you have generated and converted to apply it to your cultivation base. $(br2)Gathering aspects are the final connection in the chain and can connect to any converter aspect.
